Latin Small Letter F With Hook Alt Code and Symbol

The Alt code for Latin Small Letter F With Hook is 159. Hold Alt, type 159 on the numeric keypad, then release Alt. Latin Small Letter F With Hook also has the Unicode codepoint U+0192, so you can type it with Alt+402 on Windows, search for U+0192 in macOS's Character Viewer, use ƒ in HTML, or \0192 in CSS. If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, use the Character Viewer, the HTML entity, or copy the character directly — the Alt key method requires a physical numpad. On a US Mac keyboard, press ⌥F for Latin Small Letter F With Hook; shortcuts can differ on other layouts. HTML also defines the named entity ƒ for Latin Small Letter F With Hook, but the numeric form ƒ is safer when compatibility is uncertain.

How to type latin small letter f with hook on Windows

  1. Turn Num Lock on so the numeric keypad is active.
  2. Hold the left Alt key.
  3. Type 1 5 9 on the numeric keypad.
  4. Release Alt. The Latin Small Letter F With Hook character (ƒ) appears.

If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, see how to type symbols without a numpad.

How to type latin small letter f with hook on macOS

On a US keyboard layout, press ⌥F to insert Latin Small Letter F With Hook. This shortcut assumes a US layout; other layouts may remap it.

If the shortcut does not work on your layout, open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space, search for "Latin Small Letter F With Hook" and click the character.

How to use latin small letter f with hook in code

  • HTML: or , also
  • CSS: content:"\0192"; ()
  • Python: \u0192 or chr(0x192)
  • JavaScript: \u0192 or String.fromCodePoint(0x192)
  • JSON: "\u0192"

Frequently asked questions

What is the Alt code for Latin Small Letter F With Hook?

The legacy Alt code for Latin Small Letter F With Hook is 159. Hold Alt, type 1 5 9 on the numeric keypad, then release Alt.

How do I type ƒ without a numpad?

Use the Windows Character Viewer (Win+.), the macOS Character Viewer (⌃⌘Space), an HTML entity such as ƒ, or copy the character directly from this page.

Why does Alt+402 not work?

Alt+402 only works on a keyboard with a physical numeric keypad. It also requires the application to accept the numeric-keypad input path. Laptops without a numpad need an alternative method.

What is the Unicode for Latin Small Letter F With Hook?

The Unicode codepoint for Latin Small Letter F With Hook is U+0192. You can use this value in HTML as ƒ, in CSS as \0192, and in Word with Alt+X.

How do I type ƒ on a Mac?

On a US Mac keyboard, press ⌥F. If that does not work on your layout, open ⌃⌘Space and search for U+0192.
